manual_posting_alternative.description: If n8n automation isn't working, use manual posting workflow
process: Sunday: Batch create 7 videos for the week
Sunday: Schedule posts for 9am and 6pm PT each day
Daily: Respond to comments within 1 hour of posting

video_hosting.recommended: Google Drive - easiest for n8n to access

error_handling.if_tiktok_upload_fails: Send error notification to GChat, retry in 10 minutes
error_handling.if_instagram_upload_fails: Continue with TikTok only, manual post to Instagram later

monitoring.gchat_notifications: Sent on success, failure, and daily summary
monitoring.execution_logs: Check n8n workflow executions tab for errors
monitoring.manual_check: Review TikTok/Instagram apps daily to ensure posts went live

advanced_features.auto_reply_to_comments: n8n workflow polls TikTok comments every hour, auto-replies with link for keywords: 'link?', 'where?', 'buy?'
advanced_features.engagement_tracking: n8n workflow fetches TikTok Analytics API every 6 hours, updates engagement-tracker.json automatically
advanced_features.viral_detector: If post hits 50k views in first 24h, send urgent GChat notification + auto-create Spark Ad

note: Full n8n workflow JSON can be exported from n8n.aws.metafb.cloud once configured. This is a blueprint for manual setup.
